svg.title: Do not populate
svg.desc: Three empty PCB footprints marked DNP, do not populate. Media server: watching via debrid and Stremio, one or two films kept local. HDD array: one 1 TB SSD is enough for about a week of camera footage. Virtual router: OPNsense dropped, the ISP gateway stays the router.

g.text: DNP: what PCB designers print next to parts they leave off the board.
about a week of camera footage
the ISP gateway stays the router
